events.quote: The said order was preceded by a Summon issued under Section 70 of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 (hereinafter referred to as the “CGST Act”) on 25th August, 2020.
In response to the said summons, a reply was submitted on 1st September, 2020.

After the aforesaid order, a Show Cause Notice dated 24th June, 2025 was issued to the petitioner in the form of demand for the reasons mentioned in the said Show Cause Notice, which was based on an investigation.
The said Show Cause Notice was duly responded to by the petitioner vide reply dated 23rd July, 2025.
Impugned in the present petition is the order dated 23th December, 2025 passed by the Assistant Commissioner, GST South Commissionerate, operative part of which reads thus:-

document_contents.quote: M/s. SREI Equipment Finance Pvt Ltd (GSTIN; 07MKCS3431L1Z4) is one such recipients of M/ s. AGTSPL that has availed input tax credit on the basis of invoices without any underlying supply of goods and services or both issued by M/s. AGTSPL.

GSTR-2A data data of the Noticee revealed that they have received Input Tax Credit amounting to Rs. 53,46,000/- on the basis of invoices issued by M/s. AGTSPL without rendering services as detailed in Table-II above.

Self disclosed information provided by the Noticee revealed that they have availed Input Tax Credit amounting to Rs. 67,50,000/- during period F.Y. 2018-19 on the basis of invoices issued by M/ s. AGTSPL as detailed in Tabler.

A copy of the Order dated 08.10.2021 passed by the National Company Law Tribunal Kolkata Bench in C.P.(IB) No.294 of 2021 (Reserve Bank of India Vs. SREI Equipment Finance Ltd.) is enclosed and marked as Annexure-2 to this reply petition.

defects_argued.quote: The least that was expected of the respondents was to deal with the said issue in its order impugned..
That being so, we deem it appropriate to quash and set-aside the impugned order dated 23rd December, 2025 passed by the respondents.

outcome.quote: The petition, as such, stands allowed in above terms.
